description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Furystoke Giant
When Furystoke Giant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Furystoke Giant enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Furystoke Giant
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
